test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian Carnatic musicians received the Padma Vibhushan award in 1991 and established the Academy of Performing Arts and Research in Switzerland?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Mangalampalli Balamuralikrishna.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangalampalli Balamuralikrishna **was an Indian Carnatic vocalist, musician, multi-instrumentalist, playback singer, composer, and character actor.
 
• He was awarded the Madras Music Academy's Sangeetha Kalanidhi in **1978.**
 
• Balamuralikrishna started his career at the age of six. In his lifetime, he gave over** 25,000 concerts **worldwide. 
 
• Balamuralikrishna has experimented with the Carnatic music system by keeping its rich tradition untouched.
 
• Balamuralikrishna has over** 400 compositions **to his credit and is one of the very few people to have composed in all th**e 72 Melakarta **Ragas and has created several ragas, with **4 notes and 3 notes** and also has invented a new Tala system. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Kishan Maharaj **

 
 
• Pandit Kishan Maharaj was a renowned Tabla player of India who had given some of the most cherished and splendid compositions to the country. He belonged to the Benares Gharana of Hindustani classical music.
 
• Pandit Kishan Maharaj was born on **3rd September 1923 **in Kabir Chaura locality of Benaras in Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan **
 
 
• Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan was awarded the Padma Shri in 1991, followed by Padma Bhushan** in 2006 and Padma Vibhushan in 2018.**
 
• **In 2003, he was honored with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artistes.**
 
 
 
• **Pandit Chhannulal Mishra **
 
 
• Pandit Chhannulal Mishra has been selected for the conferment of this year’s Padma Vibhushan, one of the highest civilian awards in the country. He is among the seven recipients whose names have been approved by the President for** Padma Vibhushan Award 2020.**
